title: Ryan Garcia vs. Conor Benn Livestream: Here’s How to Watch the Boxing Title Bout Online
summary: Livestream the welterweight title match live from T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas on Sept 12.
contentText:

In partnership with Golden Boy Promotions and Zuffa Boxing, one of the biggest title fights of the year happens in Sin City this weekend. Two top boxers face off in the main event, as American Ryan Garcia (25-2-0) defends his WBC welterweight title belt against English fighter Conor Benn (25-1-0) on Saturday (Sept. 12).

The Garcia vs. Benn bout takes place at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas with a start time of 5 p.m. ET/2 p.m. PT. The main card begins at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT, with the main event starting around 11 p.m. ET/8 p.m. PT.

How to Watch Ryan Garcia vs. Conor Benn Live Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Sept. 12

- Online Streaming: Paramount+

watch on Paramount+

What Is Ryan Garcia’s and Conor Benn’s Walkout Music?

Although Golden Boy Promotions or Zuffa Boxing has yet to announce each fighter’s walkout songs , both usually go out to the octagon to the same songs during their matches. Garcia has walked out to “Oceans (Where Feet May Fail)” by Hillsong United, while Conor Benn prefers to walk out to “Ready or Not” by Fugees.
